why: [R-ENF-02]'s ratchet for scripts/check_lever_directions.py, adopted 13-Sep-2026. The four inverted levers the gate was written from were all repaired in the same commit that adopted it, so this list holds exactly one entry and it is not a sign error. CLHO's 'CBE facility-cost path (WACC glide)' slider is labelled 'sharp depreciation' at one end and 'firm / tailwind' at the other: those labels describe a CURRENCY path, not a cost-of-capital glide, and they arrived with the generic min:-3/max:3/impact:1 template that several pages carry in place of levers sized from their own study's published variants. The direction therefore cannot be read off the page, and it is not repaired here because choosing what that lever should say is a study decision about CLHO, not a gate's to make. Whoever re-issues CLHO sizes it from the study's own cost-of-capital grid and relabels both ends with the rate each stands for; the entry is then removed. The build breaks on any NEW inverted or unreadable rate lever. Keys became TICKER::lever name on 13-Sep-2026 when the levers moved out of the pages into assets/levers.js and the gate started reading that one file instead of 93 pages. This list may only ever get SHORTER (--prune).
